library(fredr)
library(fpp3)

fredr_set_key("ceec410cf8cc56d48b14af7fbc5ed297")

housing <- fredr(series_id = "HOUSTNSA") |>
  transmute(
    Month  = yearmonth(date),
    starts = value
  ) |>
  as_tsibble(index = Month) |>
  filter_index("1959 Jan" ~ .)
